annotations.title: Clear messages from a track's Inbox

description: Removes messages from the track's Inbox that will never be rows, like newsletters or one-off mails, so check_tracks stops counting them. Give each as read_inbox listed it (row, time, subject). Tell the person what you cleared. Don't clear a message a hack should read: build the hack instead.
name: dismiss_inbox
title: Clear messages from a track's Inbox
